string.name: light_name
string.description: Spoken and shown name of the tool

string.name: light_launcher_label
string.description: Launcher name, so the user can say Open Light Detector

string.name: light_button
string.description: Button on the camera screen that opens the tool

resources.string: Open light detector. Plays a tone that rises with brightness, and names colours.

string.name: light_help
string.description: Spoken list of what can be said in this tool

resources.string: In light mode, a tone rises with brightness. Turn your head to find the light. You can say: how bright is it, where\'s the light, is it blinking, quiet, or carry on. Say what colour is this to name the colour of what\'s in the middle of the view, and again to check again. Say light mode to go back to the tone, or close.

string.name: light_probe_on
string.description: Spoken when the light probe starts

resources.string: Light probe on. The tone rises with brightness. Say how bright, what colour is this, or quiet.

string.name: light_tone_off
string.description: Spoken when the tone is paused

resources.string: Tone off. Say carry on to hear it again.

string.name: light_level
string.description: Answer to how bright is it; %1$s is the level, e.g. Dim

resources.string: %1$s. That\'s the camera\'s estimate, so it\'s only relative.
About even. Turn your head slowly and follow the tone up.

string.name: light_blinking
string.description: A light in view is blinking

resources.string: Nothing\'s blinking that I can see. Hold still for a few seconds and ask again.
I couldn\'t get a picture from the glasses. Say again to try once more.

string.name: light_colour_mode
string.description: Spoken when switching to colour mode

resources.string: Colour mode. Hold it in front of you, in the middle.
Say what colour is this, or again, to check a colour. Say light mode for the tone.

string.name: light_swatch_description
string.description: TalkBack description of the colour swatch; %1$s is the spoken answer

resources.string: No colour yet. Say what colour is this.
